argument_summary: The current admissible record does not support clean certification without caveats. It does support a narrower position: certification remains defensible on a constrained basis because aggregate launch readiness passes by 2.1 percentage points and no severity-one incidents were observed, while the known shelter-placement weakness is expressly disclosed and managed through monitoring and rollback controls. The audit concern appears overbroad to the extent it treats the actor position as claiming clean compliance today. The supportable claim is certification with a disclosed limitation, not certification on the theory that the draft runbook eliminates the disclosure obligation.
claims_about_business_cost: Unnecessary escalation would add delay even though the admissible evidence already supports a narrower, governable certification theory. The record shows launch readiness passes overall and no severity-one incidents occurred, so treating the issue as requiring outright escalation rather than caveated treatment would overread the evidence. The business-cost point is not that policy should be relaxed, but that the supported posture is bounded certification with disclosure and monitoring rather than a broader adverse inference.
claims_about_policy: Policy does not permit treating the draft mitigation as a substitute for disclosure. The policy standard for certification without material caveats requires either no current material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible evidence does not show that. At the same time, the policy does not foreclose certification categorically; it distinguishes clean certification from certification that preserves the unresolved limitation. On this record, the policy-consistent path is caveated certification with corrected model-card disclosure of the emergency shelter placement limitation for the named launch use case.
concessions: The present record does not support clean certification without material caveats.
The emergency shelter placement slice remains below target, concentrated in family placement prioritization.
The draft mitigation runbook is incomplete because the alert threshold and accountable owner remain TBD.
The current model-card draft is not aligned with the admissible record because it says there are no known material limitations.
